{{Quote|The Hutt Council records.''"<br />"''Every dirty deed those criminals have slithered through&hellip;worth a fortune, baby.|Sy Snootles and Ziro Desilijic Tiure|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>}}
The '''Hutt Council records''' were a set of information contained on a [[Holodiary/Legends|holodiary]] that detailed all of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council's]] criminal dealings. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it fell into the possession of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], which caused him to be targeted by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and the Hutt Council. After killing Ziro, [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] eventually retrieved the holodiary from the [[Tomb of Ziro the Hutt's father/Legends|grave of Ziro Desilijic Tiure's father]] on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] and delivered it to Jabba.
